finding: The current analyzer can return pass when post-bound correlated old-audio windows are absent without requiring a minimum amount of discriminative post-bound source/control evidence. The runtime harness checks WAV duration, but duration can include natural TTS silence. Therefore a source whose interval after cancel+declared in-flight bound is mostly or entirely silent could make NO_POST_BOUND_OLD_AUDIO trivially true even though the run does not strongly discriminate whether later old-generation audible material would have survived. Existing synthetic regressions use deterministic broadband source across the whole interval and therefore do not cover this false-green class.

evidence.current_source_activity_role: source_active only gates whether an individual window can be called old_audio_present; there is no fail-closed minimum count/duration of eligible post-bound windows
evidence.existing_regression_shape: 2-second deterministic broadband source, so post-bound source activity is guaranteed by the test fixture rather than verified by analyzer invariant

required_minimal_repair_before_first_ter: Add an explicit predeclared --min-post-bound-observation-ms with default/fixed promotion value >=500 ms, or bind the canonical G2 value directly.
Fail EVIDENCE_INVALID if the cancel capture does not contain at least that much aligned post-bound timeline after cancel_offset_ms + max_inflight_ms.

Require the full-playback control to demonstrate enough post-bound discriminative old-source audibility/energy in that interval. Prefer a deterministic exact local-TTS test utterance with verified active/control-correlated windows; alternatively define and persist a stricter equivalent evidence metric before execution.
Record eligible post-bound duration/window count, control-correlated active duration/window count, capture-covered duration, and the minimum threshold in the analyzer receipt.
Add a regression where the source becomes silent immediately after the declared bound and prove the analyzer returns EVIDENCE_INVALID rather than NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE.
Keep the existing long-tail PRODUCT_NEGATIVE regression and bounded-tail positive regression.

runtime_subject_law.if_no_exact_repaired_s2_subject_dispatch: Repair H4 together with already-open H1/H2/H3 before the single promotion-bearing S2 dispatch.
runtime_subject_law.if_an_exact_subject_is_already_nontermin: Do not stale it merely for bookkeeping. Let it finish and reconcile only the evidence scope it actually discriminates; do not use it to terminalize G2 if H4 coverage is absent. Then close H4 in the smallest adjacent same-G2 discriminator.
runtime_subject_law.if_a_green_subject_lacks_postbound_cover: EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT_FOR_TERMINAL_G2, not PRODUCT_PASS and not PRODUCT_NEGATIVE.

next_exact_action: Trigger4 refreshes current runtime ownership. If no repaired G2 S2 subject is already bound/nonterminal, fuse H1/H2/H3/H4 into the existing single runtime harness/analyzer and dispatch exactly once; do not create another playback authority or another G2 semantic generation.
